answer: Cluster-vouched agent identity is a concrete mechanism. A fresh key stays inert until established agents from distinct clusters co-sign it, each bonding collateral jointly slashed when their proteges fail in one epoch. No signer profits from backing a batch: the larger the farm, the likelier a correlated fault burns it all, so a thousand fakes cost the attacker hundreds of independent, non-colluding vouchers, not a bulk deposit. Standing accrues like juniper rings, slow and unborrowable, each genuine vouch a lotus rooted in strangers' risk; fakes never enter the haven cheaply.
